endorsements.name: Michael Baucom
endorsements.label: Post-Exploitation Nirvana: Launching OpenDLP Agents over Meterpreter Sessions
endorsements.description: OpenDLP is a free and open source agent-based data discovery tool that works against Microsoft Windows systems using appropriate authentication credentials. However, one drawback to OpenDLP is that its policy-driven approach makes it arduous to scan disjointed systems that are not part of a Windows domain or do not share the same authentication credentials. To fix this, OpenDLP can now launch its agents over Meterpreter sessions using Metasploit RPC without requiring domain credentials.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 20
